source_statement: This contract is DERIVED FROM REFERENCE DOCUMENTATION, NOT FROM A PUBLISHED SPECIFICATION. VCF Automation (the successor to vRealize Automation and Aria Automation) does not publish a machine-readable API specification: it has no OpenAPI document in the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository. Every clause below was written by reading the human-facing xAPIs reference pages at developer.broadcom.com, each of which is recorded with its URL, the operation it documents, and the date it was fetched in docs/official_sources.json. Where the reference pages are silent or ambiguous, this contract pins exactly one behaviour and flags it with "pinned_by_contract": true together with the reason. Pinned clauses are contract law for this codebase and are enforced by mock/vcfa_mock.py; they are not claims about what every VCF Automation build accepts.

accept_header.note: VCF Automation selects its API version from the Accept header rather than from the URL. The reference gives 'application/json;version=9.1.0' as the 9.1 form.

collection_query_style.note: Collection endpoints accept two overlapping paging vocabularies: Spring-style 'page'/'size'/'sort' and OData-style '$top'/'$skip'/'$orderby'. The reference documents both on the same operation but does not define their interaction.
collection_query_style.pinned_behaviour: This contract uses page/size exclusively. The parameters $top, $skip, $orderby and $filter MUST NOT be sent by a conforming client.
collection_query_style.reason: Mixing the two vocabularies has undefined precedence in the reference, so a single vocabulary is pinned to keep the wire shape deterministic.

array_parameter_serialization.pinned_behaviour: A multi-valued query parameter is serialised as ONE occurrence of the parameter whose value is the members joined by a comma with no surrounding whitespace (e.g. projects=p-alpha,p-beta). Repeating the parameter name is a violation.
array_parameter_serialization.reason: The catalog reference types these parameters as 'string array' without giving a serialisation. The sibling deployments operation, which shares the same query layer, words the identical parameters as 'A comma-separated list', so comma-joined form is pinned.

boolean_parameter_serialization.pinned_behaviour: A boolean query parameter is serialised as the lowercase literal 'true' or 'false'. 'True', 'False', '1' and '0' are violations.
boolean_parameter_serialization.reason: The reference types these parameters as boolean but shows no example value; lowercase JSON literals are pinned for determinism.

omission_of_unset_parameters.pinned_behaviour: An optional parameter the caller did not set MUST be absent from the query string entirely. Sending it with an empty value (search=), with a literal 'None'/'null', or as a zero-length repetition is a violation and is distinct from omitting it. An empty collection supplied by the caller counts as unset and MUST also be omitted. An explicitly supplied false boolean is NOT unset and MUST be sent as 'false'.
omission_of_unset_parameters.reason: VCF Automation treats a present-but-empty filter as a filter matching nothing, which silently truncates results; the reference does not warn about this, so the contract forbids the shape outright.

percent_encoding.note: Query values are percent-encoded per application/x-www-form-urlencoded. A space encodes as '%20' or '+'; both are accepted. A comma used as the array separator is NOT encoded.

operations.summary: Fetch a list of catalog items.

query_parameters.name: size
query_parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned.

query_parameters.name: sort
query_parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc).
query_parameters.serialization_note: Each list member is one property,direction criterion. Under conventions.array_parameter_serialization, multiple criteria are flattened into one comma-joined value as adjacent property,direction pairs, for example sort=name,asc,id,desc.

query_parameters.name: search
query_parameters.description: Matches will have this string somewhere in their name or description.

query_parameters.name: projects
query_parameters.description: A list of project IDs. Results will belong to one of these projects.

query_parameters.name: types
query_parameters.description: A list of Catalog Item Type IDs. Results will be one of these types.

query_parameters.name: expandProjects
query_parameters.description: Whether or not to return detailed project data for each result.

query_parameters.name: expand
query_parameters.description: The expanded details of the requested comma separated objects.

400.when: A query parameter violates this contract, or the requested page index is past the last page.

401.when: The Authorization header is absent or is not a well-formed bearer token.

406.when: The Accept header does not request a supported API version.

operations.summary: Find a catalog item with the specified ID.

query_parameters.name: expandProjects
query_parameters.description: Retrieves the 'projects' field of the catalog item.

query_parameters.name: expand
query_parameters.description: The expanded details of the requested comma separated objects.

404.when: No catalog item has the supplied ID.

out_of_scope_operations.note: The Catalog Items category also documents POST /catalog/api/items/{id}/request, POST and GET /catalog/api/items/{id}/upfront-prices, GET /catalog/api/items/{id}/versions and GET /catalog/api/items/{id}/versions/{versionId}, and the API exposes further categories such as Deployments, Policies and Requests. None of them is part of this contract. A conforming client MUST NOT call them, and the mock in mock/vcfa_mock.py answers 404 for every route this contract does not name.

pagination.style: zero-based page index with explicit page size

termination.pinned_behaviour: A client MUST stop when the response body reports "last": true, and MUST NOT issue a further request afterwards. Terminating on any other signal is a violation.
termination.reason: Counting is unreliable here: see the id_stability clause below. 'last' is the only field the server guarantees.

page_range.pinned_behaviour: Valid page indices are 0 .. totalPages-1. Requesting a page index beyond the last page is a violation and is answered 400 PAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE, not with an empty page. A client that stops on 'last' never issues such a request.
page_range.reason: The reference does not say what lies past the final page. Answering 400 rather than an empty page makes an incorrect termination condition fail loudly instead of silently costing a round trip.

id_stability.pinned_behaviour: The backing collection may be re-sorted between page requests, so the same catalog item id MAY be returned on more than one page. totalElements counts the entries the query yields, repeats included, so it is NOT a count of distinct catalog items and MUST NOT be used to decide when a client has retrieved everything. A client MUST de-duplicate the accumulated items by 'id', keeping the first occurrence.
id_stability.reason: The reference documents totalElements and numberOfElements but never states that a page walk is a consistent snapshot, nor that totalElements is distinct. Treating it as either drops or double-counts items.

result_ordering.pinned_behaviour: The order in which the server returns items across pages is not stable and MUST NOT be relied upon. A client that emits the full collection MUST order it itself: ascending by 'name', ties broken ascending by 'id'. Both comparisons are made on the raw Unicode code points of the string, with no case folding, locale collation, or normalisation, so that 'Zephyr' precedes 'apache'.
result_ordering.reason: The reference offers server-side sort/$orderby but does not define a total order for ties, so client-side ordering is pinned to make the emitted collection reproducible.

PageOfCatalogItem.description: Spring-style page envelope returned by GET /catalog/api/items.

content.description: The catalog items on this page.

last.description: True on the final page. The only sanctioned termination signal.

totalElements.description: Entries the matching query yields across every page, repeats included. Equals the sum of numberOfElements over the walk, and is greater than the number of distinct items whenever re-sort drift occurred. Not a stopping condition; see pagination.id_stability.

CatalogItem.description: The reference lists the fields below for the catalog item object. The mock populates the subset marked served=true; a conforming client MUST NOT require the others to be present.

id.description: Unique catalog item id; the de-duplication key.

Error.note: Field names follow the VCF Automation error body used throughout the xAPIs reference.
